title: BUBIX Middle East: build digital trust, operate lasting services
lead: V3.2 / Middle East business plan - UAE-led development / Build & Operate
paras: Prioritize national and major industry platforms; validate commercialization through enterprise applications and recurring services. The regional role connects business resources, proposals, contracts, collections and local operations.

The proposed initial capital range is USD 5-10 million. The currency, beneficiary, target year and pre-tax or after-tax basis of the annual profit ambition of 20-30 million remain undefined. Sensitivity analysis therefore tests alternative interpretations.
The six decision materials from v3.1-JD are retained. Supplier economics, local platform operations and equity-related returns are modeled separately, within the existing 27-chapter report structure.
note: M01 p2 / C01 p3 / C02 p6,9. Public reading edition. Original background materials are not published.

title: Brand mission: bridging crypto ecosystems and real economies

paras: Commercial expression of the mission: enable organizations to verify identities, rights, data and transactions together, and collaborate under explicit rules.

Business value: streamline credential verification, reduce reconciliation, clarify records of asset rights, and constrain and trace AI-agent actions. Any claimed improvement must come from before-and-after pilot measurements.
Proposed campaign statement: VALUE, IN CLEAR VIEW. The two CORE elements express connection, verification and coordinated completion.
National-level describes project scope and the level of cooperation. Claims of state ownership, government guarantees or capability limited to two countries require evidence.

title: The target gap: USD 10 million revenue is not a universal answer
lead: Conditional Y3 pre-tax contribution is USD 3 million; compare it with the profit ambition on a consistent basis.
paras: USD 3 million platform pre-tax contribution equals RMB 21 million at the assumed rate of 7, close only to the lower end of the platform-level RMB pre-tax interpretation.
At an illustrative 30% BUBIX economic share, the corresponding interest is USD 900,000 or RMB 6.3 million. This is neither consolidated revenue nor immediately distributable cash.
If the ambition is USD 20 million annual platform profit, the USD 10 million revenue path is insufficient. Required revenue is at least USD 66.67 million at an assumed 30% margin.
Present year-one delivery milestones alongside mature-platform conditions. Year-one contract scale cannot establish mature-platform profit, and token valuation cannot close the operating gap.
note: H-REV. Illustrative economic shares do not replace consolidation, equity-method or dividend accounting.

Equity-related sharing is sensitivity analysis only. Service fees, dividends, investment recovery and token rights each require contracts and settlement rules.

title: External scale reference: possibility is not an order
lead: Zetrix AI illustrates mature-platform scale, but is not equivalent to BUBIX.
paras: Zetrix AI Berhad Annual Report 2025, Note 31, reports blockchain- and AI-related service revenue of RM 643.542 million in 2025 and RM 362.778 million in 2024.
This is a mixed service category within a listed group, not BUBIX revenue, a single-country project or profit. Do not directly apply that scale as a target for a new Middle East operation.
Appropriate use: show how build + operate can produce a different revenue structure from one-off software projects. BUBIX economics still depend on customer contracts, actual usage and attribution.
Without verified historical financials, justify targets using scope, work packages, customer volumes and funding constraints rather than unverified 2023 figures.
note: P02 https://www.insage.com.my/interactiveAR/ZETRIX/interactiveAR2025/262/ ; printed p261, Note 31. This is a cited reference, not an updated financial comparison.
